title: Project Monolith
author: Ill-Past4609
selftext:
https://project-monolith.vercel.app

Looking for honest feedback especially around player retention.  
What can be added , removed , etc improved.

Their is a feedback button that does work in game and I receive all your feedback.

I will take any criticism! Good or bad.

Been using nodejs   
ChatGPT   
Cursor  
Claude.ai  
Photoshop  
Adobe firefly
